name: Cursor
description: inference@1 agent provider cursor over the Cursor SDK.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Cursor conversation mode for each prompt.

utilityModel.title: Utility model
utilityModel.description: Model for small side jobs such as naming sessions; may end in an effort (composer-2-high). Empty turns them off.

hideAuto.title: Hide Auto
hideAuto.description: Leave Cursor's Auto model out of the picker. Sessions already on Auto keep using it.

maxMode.title: Max mode
maxMode.description: Allow Max-mode variants: the largest context windows, billed at Max-mode rates.

hideBuiltinTools.title: Hide built-in tools
hideBuiltinTools.description: Remove Cursor's own tools (shell, read, edit, grep, ...) so only valet's tools are offered.

autoReview.title: Cursor Auto-review
autoReview.description: Let Cursor's classifier review local tool calls. Unset keeps the SDK default.

sandbox.title: Cursor sandbox
sandbox.description: Run Cursor's shell commands in its local sandbox. Unset keeps the SDK default.

denyTools.title: Denied tools
denyTools.description: Built-in tools Cursor may never offer, e.g. shell.

tools.title: Built-in tool set
tools.description: The built-in tools offered. Unset keeps Cursor's defaults; "mcp" is always kept so valet's tools stay.

secret.title: API key secret
secret.description: Secret name for the Cursor API key (~/.valet/secrets/<name>, then <NAME>).

settingSources.title: Settings files to load
settingSources.description: Cursor settings layers to load. None by default: valet supplies the persona and AGENTS.md.

idleCloseMs.title: Close idle sessions after (ms)
idleCloseMs.description: The next prompt resumes the session. 0 keeps them open.

modelParams.title: Per-model params
modelParams.description: Cursor params pinned per model id, e.g. { "claude-opus-4-8": { "thinking": "false" } }. Wins over the picker.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Replaces Cursor's catalog. Rename or hide models on the Models page instead.

effortParam.title: Effort param
effortParam.description: Cursor param name when the catalog does not know the model. Default effort.
